text:
You want to build a set of AI tools—an AI game, decision-making tool, therapist/friend/coach bot, and custom market research tool—using existing AI capabilities packaged into practical products.

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience building machine learning and NLP solutions with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and related tooling. I can help you turn these ideas into reliable, well-structured AI workflows and user-facing tools.

A relevant example: I built a small Streamlit app for Cobalt Coffee Roasters that grouped 38k marketplace reviews into themes and tracked sentiment per theme each week, creating 12 stable themes and replacing about 2 days a month of manual tagging. I also built an LLM evaluation harness for Quillstack that graded tutor-bot answers against a 400-item rubric before each release, with judge-human agreement kappa 0.71 and 2 regressions caught before release.

I’d be glad to help scope and package these tools.
